script_review: generate-sbom.py retains its default checkout root, adds explicit --source-root passed through source-reading functions, validates the directory, and fails present unreadable/malformed source input with a fixed diagnostic. JSON serialization, no-shell calls, version and repo arguments unchanged. Missing optional directories remain allowed. No external secret or network used. All old CLI usages remain valid.

findings.input: gh API successful workflow run count
findings.impact: Malformed null count made test return2 inside if; CI-green printed success and exited0.
findings.resolution: Positive decimal count regex plus exact SHA/ref-type validation.
findings.baseline: Actual original step with mocked gh response null exits0 and prints CI green confirmed.
findings.validation: Actual corrected step accepts1/2 and rejects0/null/empty/text/negative/multiline; invalidSHA cases reject.

findings.input: Manual dispatch branch differs from selected tag
findings.sink: SBOM root derived from generator checkout
findings.impact: Tagged archive described dispatch-branch dependencies instead of published bytes.
findings.resolution: Extract exact generated tarball, pass --source-root to generator, trap scratch cleanup.
findings.baseline: Two-commit real Git fixture emits only dispatch-only-dependency.
findings.validation: Corrected actual workflow body emits tagged-dependency only.

findings.input: Present corrupt/unreadable dependency lock or workflow source
findings.sink: catch then continue during SBOM enumeration
findings.impact: Release could attest incomplete dependency inventory with success status.
findings.resolution: Refuse present invalid/unreadable inputs; root/packages JSON must be objects; fixed diagnostic and nonzero.
findings.baseline: Malformed { lock produces exit0 SBOM with no dependency components.
findings.validation: Malformed JSON, array root and array packages map produce nonzero, fixed diagnostic and no output.
